titulo.alumno:
«Страдательное причастие настоящего времени»
Present passive participle

intro: The present passive participle describes something that receives a current or habitual action: обсуждаемая тема, читаемый текст.

piezas.titulo: The present passive participle describes something that receives a current or habitual action: обсуждаемая тема, читаемый текст.
texto: The present passive participle describes something that receives a current or habitual action: обсуждаемая тема, читаемый текст.
It is formed mainly from transitive verbs; it is more common in written language and can sound heavy in conversation.

frases.estudio: На встрече обсуждалась тема, изучаемая в университете.
frases.alumno: At the meeting, a topic that is studied at the university was discussed.

frases.estudio: Это правило часто встречается в читаемых нами статьях.
frases.alumno: This rule often appears in the articles we read.

opciones.explicacion: Обсуждаемая presents the topic as the object of the action.

opciones.texto: a topic that debates other people
opciones.explicacion: This form does not express the relation the question asks about.

opciones.texto: a topic that was debated yesterday
opciones.explicacion: Check which word governs the case or the structure.
